<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ui_script"><sys_ui_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><description/><global>false</global><ignore_in_now_experience>false</ignore_in_now_experience><name>x_1800027_leve_sys.LeaveRequestCalculati</name><script><![CDATA[var LeaveRequestCalculations = {
    updateDuration: function() {
        var startDate = g_form.getValue('start_date');
        var endDate = g_form.getValue('end_date');
        var country = g_form.getValue('country');
        var isHalfDay = g_form.getValue('half_day') === 'true';
        
        // Exit if we don't have all required fields
        if (!startDate || !endDate || !country) {
            return;
        }
        
        // If half-day is selected, ensure end date equals start date
        if (isHalfDay && startDate !== endDate) {
            g_form.setValue('end_date', startDate);
        }
        
        // Call server to calculate duration
        var ga = new GlideAjax('x_1800027_leve_sys.HolidayAjax');
        ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'calculateDuration');
        ga.addParam('sysparm_start_date', startDate);
        ga.addParam('sysparm_end_date', endDate);
        ga.addParam('sysparm_country', country);
        ga.addParam('sysparm_half_day', isHalfDay);
        
        ga.getXMLAnswer(function(duration) {
            g_form.setValue('duration', duration);
            
            // Now get non-working days for display
            LeaveRequestCalculations.showNonWorkingDays(startDate, endDate, country, duration, isHalfDay);
        });
    },
    
    showNonWorkingDays: function(startDate, endDate, country, duration, isHalfDay) {
        var ga = new GlideAjax('x_1800027_leve_sys.HolidayAjax');
        ga.addParam('sysparm_name', 'getNonWorkingDays');
        ga.addParam('sysparm_start_date', startDate);
        ga.addParam('sysparm_end_date', endDate);
        ga.addParam('sysparm_country', country);
        
        ga.getXMLAnswer(function(answer) {
            try {
                var nonWorkingDays = JSON.parse(answer);
                
                if (nonWorkingDays.length > 0) {
                    // Group by type
                    var holidays = [];
                    var weekends = [];
                    
                    for (var i = 0; i < nonWorkingDays.length; i++) {
                        var day = nonWorkingDays[i];
                        if (day.type === 'holiday') {
                            holidays.push(day);
                        } else {
                            weekends.push(day);
                        }
                    }
                    
                    // Build message
                    var message = '';
                    
                    if (holidays.length > 0) {
                        message += 'Holidays in selected range:\n';
                        for (var j = 0; j < holidays.length; j++) {
                            var holiday = holidays[j];
                            var holidayDate = new GlideDateTime(holiday.date).getDisplayValue();
                            message += '- ' + holidayDate + ': ' + holiday.reason.replace('Holiday: ', '') + '\n';
                        }
                    }
                    
                    if (weekends.length > 0) {
                        if (message) message += '\n';
                        message += 'Weekends in selected range: ' + weekends.length + ' days\n';
                    }
                    
                    message += '\nWorking days: ' + duration;
                    if (isHalfDay) {
                        message += ' (includes half-day adjustment)';
                    }
                    
                    g_form.addInfoMessage(message);
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('Error processing non-working days: ' + e);
            }
        });
    },
    
    handleHalfDayChange: function(isHalfDay) {
        if (isHalfDay) {
            var startDate = g_form.getValue('start_date');
            if (startDate) {
                g_form.setValue('end_date', startDate);
            }
            g_form.setReadOnly('end_date', true);
        } else {
            g_form.setReadOnly('end_date', false);
        }
        
        this.updateDuration();
    }
};]]></script><script_name>LeaveRequestCalculations</script_name><sys_class_name>sys_ui_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-07-21 10:16:10</sys_created_on><sys_id>73e6e932c336a610a7f1b813e40131f8</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>x_1800027_leve_sys.LeaveRequestCalculati</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Leave Management System" source="x_1800027_leve_sys">9b184465c3beaa10a7f1b813e4013155</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Leave Management System">9b184465c3beaa10a7f1b813e4013155</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ui_script_73e6e932c336a610a7f1b813e40131f8</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-07-21 10:16:10</sys_updated_on><ui_type>10</ui_type><use_scoped_format>false</use_scoped_format></sys_ui_script></record_update>
